glosses: palace (large residence where aristocrats usually live)

examples.text: O rei e sua família vivem no palácio real.
examples.en: The king and his family live in the royal palace.

examples.text: Eu vou te levar ao meu palácio amanhã.
examples.en: I will take you to my palace tomorrow.

examples.text: A família real mora no palácio imperial.
examples.en: The royal family lives in the Imperial Palace.

examples.text: Levei-o ao Palácio Imperial de Quioto.
examples.en: I took him to the Kyoto Imperial Palace.
